about.intro: I'm Marlon, a Full-Stack Developer focused on building simple, accessible and high-performance digital products.
about.paragraph1: I enjoy turning complex problems into clear interfaces and solutions that genuinely help people. I combine design thinking, frontend development and backend architecture to create consistent experiences from the first interaction to production.
about.paragraph2: I've worked with web applications, APIs, databases and cloud tools across the full development cycle: planning, implementation, optimization and maintenance of real products.
about.paragraph3: Today, I specialize in Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, with a strong focus on performance, accessibility, responsive design and clean code.
